title: Neil's difficult summer job in Canada 🫛 | Practise your listening with Real Easy English

lines.text: Hello Neil.
lines.ipa: hɛˈləʊ niːl.

lines.text: Hi Georgie. How are you?
lines.ipa: haɪ ˈʤɔːʤi. haʊ ɑː juː?

lines.text: I'm very well, thank you. How are you?
lines.ipa: aɪm ˈvɛri wɛl, θæŋk juː. haʊ ɑː juː?

lines.text: I'm excellent, thank you.
lines.ipa: aɪm ˈɛksᵊlᵊnt, θæŋk juː.

lines.text: Good. Neil, have you ever had a bad or difficult job?
lines.ipa: ɡʊd. niːl, hæv juː ˈɛvə hæd ə bæd ɔː ˈdɪfɪkᵊlt ʤɒb?

lines.text: Oh yes. There's one in particular that I remember.
lines.ipa: əʊ jɛs. ðeəz wʌn ɪn pəˈtɪkjələ ðæt aɪ rɪˈmɛmbə.

lines.text: Ooh, that's intriguing.
lines.ipa: uː, ðæts ɪnˈtriːɡɪŋ.

lines.text: I'm sure we're going to hear about it a bit later
lines.ipa: aɪm ʃɔː wɪə ˈɡəʊɪŋ tuː hɪər əˈbaʊt ɪt ə bɪt ˈleɪtə

lines.text: because that's what we're talking about today
lines.ipa: bɪˈkɒz ðæts wɒt wɪə ˈtɔːkɪŋ əˈbaʊt təˈdeɪ

lines.text: in Real Easy English – bad or difficult jobs we've had.
lines.ipa: ɪn rɪəl ˈiːzi ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ – bæd ɔː ˈdɪfɪkᵊlt ʤɒbz wiːv hæd.

lines.text: Yes, and people should remember that they can get a free
lines.ipa: jɛs, ænd ˈpiːpᵊl ʃʊd rɪˈmɛmbə ðæt ðeɪ kæn ɡɛt ə friː

lines.text: for this podcast at bbclearningenglish. com.
lines.ipa: fɔː ðɪs ˈpɒdkɑːst æt bbclearningenglish. kɒm.

lines.text: That's right.
lines.ipa: ðæts raɪt.

lines.text: So Neil, tell us all about your bad or difficult job.
lines.ipa: səʊ niːl, tɛl ʌs ɔːl əˈbaʊt jɔː bæd ɔː ˈdɪfɪkᵊlt ʤɒb.

lines.text: Well, what happened was I found a job picking beans on a
lines.ipa: wɛl, wɒt ˈhæpᵊnd wɒz aɪ faʊnd ə ʤɒb ˈpɪkɪŋ biːnz ɒn ə

lines.text: while I was in Canada.
lines.ipa: waɪl aɪ wɒz ɪn ˈkænədə.

lines.text: Ooh. On a farm?
lines.ipa: uː. ɒn ə fɑːm?

lines.text: Yeah, but we had to travel a long way.
lines.ipa: jeə, bʌt wiː hæd tuː ˈtrævᵊl ə lɒŋ weɪ.

lines.text: And when we got there, we discovered that you got paid
lines.ipa: ænd wɛn wiː ɡɒt ðeə, wiː dɪˈskʌvəd ðæt juː ɡɒt peɪd

lines.text: by the amount that you picked.
lines.ipa: baɪ ði əˈmaʊnt ðæt juː pɪkt.

lines.text: OK.
lines.ipa: ˌəʊˈkeɪ.

lines.text: And it cost $10 to get to this place on the coach
lines.ipa: ænd ɪt kɒst $10 tuː ɡɛt tuː ðɪs pleɪs ɒn ðə kəʊʧ

lines.text: and we worked really hard all day.
lines.ipa: ænd wiː wɜːkt ˈrɪəli hɑːd ɔːl deɪ.

lines.text: And then I got my beans and weighed them.
lines.ipa: ænd ðɛn aɪ ɡɒt maɪ biːnz ænd weɪd ðɛm.

lines.text: And I got paid $8.
lines.ipa: ænd aɪ ɡɒt peɪd $8.

lines.text: Oh wow.
lines.ipa: əʊ waʊ.

lines.text: Was it a full day's work?
lines.ipa: wɒz ɪt ə fʊl deɪz wɜːk?

lines.text: Oh yeah. Hard, hard work in the heat, in a field.
lines.ipa: əʊ jeə. hɑːd, hɑːd wɜːk ɪn ðə hiːt, ɪn ə fiːld.

lines.text: Was it fun, at least?
lines.ipa: wɒz ɪt fʌn, æt liːst?

lines.text: Were you with friends?
lines.ipa: wɜː juː wɪð frɛndz?

lines.text: It's a good story now...
lines.ipa: ɪts ə ɡʊd ˈstɔːri naʊ...

lines.text: OK.
lines.ipa: ˌəʊˈkeɪ.

lines.text: ... but at the time, it was very annoying.

lines.text: Exhausting, it sounds.

lines.text: It was exhausting.
lines.ipa: ɪt wɒz ɪɡˈzɔːstɪŋ.

lines.text: All day in the heat.
lines.ipa: ɔːl deɪ ɪn ðə hiːt.

lines.text: I had quite a difficult job – it was just a temporary one.
lines.ipa: aɪ hæd kwaɪt ə ˈdɪfɪkᵊlt ʤɒb – ɪt wɒz ʤʌst ə ˈtɛmpᵊrᵊri wʌn.

lines.text: I was working in customer service, so I had to pick up calls
lines.ipa: aɪ wɒz ˈwɜːkɪŋ ɪn ˈkʌstəmə ˈsɜːvɪs, səʊ aɪ hæd tuː pɪk ʌp kɔːlz

lines.text: who were needing help or were unhappy about the service they had
lines.ipa: huː wɜː ˈniːdɪŋ hɛlp ɔː wɜːr ʌnˈhæpi əˈbaʊt ðə ˈsɜːvɪs ðeɪ hæd

lines.text: OK. That sounds interesting.

lines.ipa: wɒt ˈdɪdᵊnt juː laɪk əˈbaʊt ðɪs ʤɒb?

lines.text: Well, the company was having a difficult time, so many or most
lines.ipa: wɛl, ðə ˈkʌmpəni wɒz ˈhævɪŋ ə ˈdɪfɪkᵊlt taɪm, səʊ ˈmɛni ɔː məʊst

lines.text: of the customers that were calling were unhappy about the service,

lines.text: and so I had to talk to people who were very angry,
lines.ipa: ænd səʊ aɪ hæd tuː tɔːk tuː ˈpiːpᵊl huː wɜː ˈvɛri ˈæŋɡri,

lines.text: and it felt like they were angry with me, even though it wasn't

lines.text: The company changed the warehouse where they kept the products

lines.text: and the delivery company at the same time,
lines.ipa: ænd ðə dɪˈlɪvᵊri ˈkʌmpəni æt ðə seɪm taɪm,

lines.text: so it was just all a big mess and I found it really stressful.

lines.text: Yeah, you say stressful.
lines.ipa: jeə, juː seɪ ˈstrɛsfᵊl.

lines.ipa: haʊ ɛls dɪd ɪt meɪk juː fiːl?

lines.text: It made me feel very anxious because I took it too personally.
lines.ipa: ɪt meɪd miː fiːl ˈvɛri ˈæŋkʃəs bɪˈkɒz aɪ tʊk ɪt tuː ˈpɜːsᵊnᵊli.

lines.text: If you heard somebody else talking about this kind of job,

lines.text: what advice would you give them?

lines.ipa: uː, aɪ wʊd seɪ, dəʊnt teɪk ɪt tuː hɑːt.

lines.text: As I said, I was taking it too personally,

lines.text: but you need to realise that you can only do your best.

lines.text: And at the end of the day, you can go home and enjoy

lines.ipa: ænd təˈmɒrəʊ ɪz ə njuː deɪ.

lines.ipa: jɛs.

lines.text: What advice would you give to people doing the job that you

lines.text: So, probably find out how much you're going to get paid, what

lines.ipa: ænd haʊ mʌʧ juː hæv tuː peɪ tuː ɡɛt tuː ðə pleɪs tuː duː ðə

lines.ipa: ˌəʊˈkeɪ. səʊ, lɛts ˈriːkæp ðə vəˈkæbjəlᵊri ðæt wiː juːzd ɪn ðə

lines.ipa: ɡʊd aɪˈdɪə.

lines.ipa: aɪ dɪd. səʊ, juː kæn dɪˈskraɪb ˈsʌmθɪŋ æz ˈstrɛsfᵊl,

lines.text: That's 'exhausting' and the feeling is 'exhausted'.

lines.text: And if something is annoying, it makes you feel annoyed.
